softCriteria: We believe Mid-market and growing organizations with significant cloud and IT infrastructure that need continuous cybersecurity monitoring but do not have a fully staffed 24/7 internal SOC. Ideal customers typically use Microsoft 365/Azure or other cloud platforms, have 100+ employees, handle sensitive customer or business data, serve enterprise customers, and have security or compliance requirements such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, customer security assessments or cyber-insurance. Strong industries include SaaS, technology, IT services, fintech, financial services, healthcare and professional services..
We believe companies with 100–2,000 employees; sweet spot: 200–1,000 employees employees are a strong fit.
